tasks.short: Answer applicants' questions about benefits and claim procedures.

steps.what: Show published claim procedures to the interviewer
Sign the written answer about the claim

outputs: filed copy of signed claim answer v1

tasks.design: The interviewer answers the applicant. A desk shows the interviewer the published claim procedures in {DOCS} and does not reply itself. If a written answer is needed, the interviewer signs it and a job sends that version. An oral answer is not turned into a denial by the desk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure text was searched while the applicant waited, and written answers went out unsigned.
tasks.enabler_now: Published procedures can be shown from a maintained page.
tasks.still_hard: The answer for this claim still depends on the case.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides the answer and whether to put it in writing.
tasks.altitude: Answering stays. Showing the published page, and sending a signed written answer, shrink.

reach.task: Rely on the signed written answer when one was sent
reach.learn: That the desk did not decide

evidence.claim: The clerk digest says a model may draft a reply from the case record and the clerk sends it.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.

assumptions: The desk never messages the applicant.
A written answer is sent only after signature.
unknowns: Which questions must be answered in writing.
research_questions: How often the question is not covered by the published page.

already_counted.description: Answering the applicant stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give social workers the information gathered in interviews.

steps.what: Record pertinent information gathered during applicant interviews
Provide social workers only what the interview supports
Sign the extract for social workers

outputs: filed copy of signed social-work extract v1

tasks.design: The interviewer records what was gathered in the interview. They choose what social workers may receive, sign that extract in {DOCS}, and a job sends only that version. The whole case file is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case files were forwarded whole because trimming them took a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: The interview record is already on the case.
tasks.still_hard: What another profession needs still has to be chosen.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides what leaves the file.
tasks.altitude: The interview and the choice stay. Sending the signed extract shrinks.

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S21] says call recording and staff dashboards need works-council consent, so interviews are not recorded into a dashboard.

assumptions: The extract is not a benefit decision.
unknowns: What social workers are allowed to see.
Whether the applicant consented to the share.
research_questions: How often the interview record is too thin to share.

already_counted.description: Choosing the extract stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Refer applicants to job openings or staff interviews under office procedures.

steps.what: Refer applicants to other staff interviews
Act in accordance with office procedures
Apply the administrative guidelines to the referral
List job openings from the vacancy table

outputs: filed copy of signed job referral v1

tasks.design: A job lists job openings from the vacancy table in {GOV_PORTAL}. The interviewer refers the applicant to other staff interviews, acts in accordance with office procedures, applies the administrative guidelines, signs the referral, and a job sends that version. The list does not choose the person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Openings and the guideline were in different places, so a referral could skip a required step.
tasks.enabler_now: Vacancies can be listed from a maintained table.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this applicant should be referred is still a judgement.
tasks.altitude: The referral decision stays. Listing openings and sending the signed referral shrink.

reach.task: See the person named in the signed referral

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S15] lists benefit eligibility as a high-risk use, and digest [S16] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so eligibility status stays with the interviewer.

assumptions: The vacancy list is not a match score.
research_questions: How often the vacancy table is stale.

already_counted.description: The referral judgement stays inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Schedule claimants for adjudication interviews on eligibility.

steps.what: Propose adjudication times from open slots
Schedule benefits claimants for adjudication interviews
Address questions of eligibility before booking
Sign the interview time for this claimant

outputs: filed copy of signed interview time v1

tasks.design: A configured calendar proposes open slots. The interviewer schedules the benefits claimant, addresses questions of eligibility, signs that time, and a job writes only that signed time to {CALENDAR}. A proposed slot is not a booking, and it is not an eligibility decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Slots were offered from memory and then double-booked.
tasks.enabler_now: Open slots can be listed from the existing calendar.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the claimant should be seen, and when, is still the interviewer's call.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer sets the time and handles the eligibility question that comes with it.

ambition.what: Offer the next open slot the same day a case is ready, and book only the signed time.

tasks.altitude: The interviewer spends the call on the claimant, not on hunting a free slot.

reach.task: Hold the interview at the signed time
reach.learn: That the booking is not the decision

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S15] lists benefit eligibility as a high-risk use, and digest [S16] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so eligibility status stays with the interviewer.

assumptions: The job writes the calendar only after signature.
A slot proposal is not a decision.
unknowns: How soon an eligibility question must be seen in person.
research_questions: How often claimants cannot take the proposed times.

already_counted.description: Scheduling and the eligibility question stay inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The eligibility interviewer spends the week on the interview and the decision. Completeness checks and filing a signed note move to a job. No model decides a benefit or scores a person.
reach: Applicants hear the decision from the interviewer, not from a generated refusal.
Social workers receive only the extract the interviewer signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a published table amount from the decision to authorize it.
Refuse any list that ranks or flags people.
role.ambitious_version: A signed decision can open the payment instruction, and the interviewer still authorizes that amount.
